description: This file defines an enum 'WindowPlacement' with static methods for calculating window frames and positioning on macOS screens, including centering, positioning at the top right, anchoring below another rect, and ensuring a window is on screen.

methods.name: centeredFrame(size:on:)
methods.description: Calculates a rectangle centered within the specified screen bounds.

methods.name: topRightFrame(size:padding:on:)
methods.description: Calculates a rectangle positioned at the top right of the specified screen bounds with padding.

methods.name: centeredFrame(size:in:)
methods.description: Calculates a rectangle centered within the provided bounds.

methods.name: topRightFrame(size:padding:in:)
methods.description: Calculates a rectangle at the top right of the specified bounds with padding.

methods.name: anchoredBelowFrame(size:anchor:padding:in:)
methods.description: Calculates a rectangle anchored below a given rect, within bounds, with padding.

methods.name: ensureOnScreen(window:defaultSize:fallback:)
methods.description: Ensures the window is on screen, repositioning if necessary, optionally using a fallback position.
